import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 100010;
    static final int M = 1000010;
    static final int inf = 1000000000;
    static final int winf = 1000000000;

    static class Road {
        int nxt, to, f;
        long w;
        Road(int nxt, int to, int f, long w) {
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.to = to;
            this.f = f;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static Road[] r = new Road[M << 1];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int cnt = 1, all;
    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[N];

    static int ss = 1, tt = 2;

    static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
        int u;
        long v;
        Node(int u, long v) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
        }
        public int compareTo(Node a) {
            return Long.compare(this.v, a.v);
        }
    }

    static int[] cur = new int[N];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
    static long[] dis = new long[N], tag = new long[N];

    static boolean dij(int s, int t, int all) {
        Arrays.fill(dis, 0, all + 1, winf);
        Arrays.fill(cur, 0, all + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= all; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        dis[t] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Node> q = new PriorityQueue<>();
        q.offer(new Node(t, 0));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node node = q.poll();
            int u = node.u;
            if (vis[u]) continue;
            vis[u] = true;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = r[i].nxt) {
                int v = r[i].to;
                long w = tag[u] + r[i ^ 1].w - tag[v];
                if (r[i ^ 1].f != 0 && dis[u] + w < dis[v]) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + w;
                    q.offer(new Node(v, dis[v]));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= all; i++) {
            tag[i] = Math.min(tag[i] + dis[i], (long)winf);
        }
        if (!vis[s]) return false;
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0, all + 1, false);
        return true;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int fl, int[] cur, boolean[] vis, long[] tag, Road[] r) {
        if (u == t || fl == 0) return fl;
        int res = 0;
        vis[u] = true;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i != 0; i = r[i].nxt) {
            if (r[i].f > 0) {
                int v = r[i].to;
                int f;
                if (!vis[v] && tag[v] + r[i].w == tag[u] && (f = dfs(v, t, Math.min(fl, r[i].f), cur, vis, tag, r)) > 0) {
                    r[i].f -= f;
                    r[i ^ 1].f += f;
                    res += f;
                    fl -= f;
                    if (fl == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        vis[u] = false;
        return res;
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int maxf = 0;
        long minw = 0;

        void work(int s, int t, int all, Road[] r, int[] head, int[] cur, boolean[] vis, long[] tag, long[] dis) {
            while (dij(s, t, all)) {
                int w = dfs(s, t, inf, cur, vis, tag, r);
                maxf += w;
                minw += (long)w * tag[s];
            }
        }
    }

    static int id(int t, int x, int n) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void work(int t, int n, int k, int d, List<Integer>[] g, Road[] r, int[] head, int[] cur, boolean[] vis, long[] tag, long[] dis, int all) {
        all += n;
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    add(id(t, u, n), id(t + 1, v, n), 1, d * (2 * p - 1), r, head);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
            add(id(t, u, n), id(t + 1, u, n), inf, 0, r, head);
        }
        add(id(t + 1, 1, n), tt, inf, c * (t + 1), r, head);
    }

    static void add(int u, int v, int f, long w, Road[] r, int[] head) {
        r[++cnt] = new Road(head[u], v, f, w);
        head[u] = cnt;
        r[++cnt] = new Road(head[v], u, 0, -w);
        head[v] = cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n_ = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m_ = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k_ = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c_ = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d_ = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        n = n_; m = m_; k = k_; c = c_; d = d_;
        all = n + 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 10; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        cnt = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            add(ss, id(0, a, n), 1, 0, r, head);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            g[u].add(v);
            g[v].add(u);
        }

        add(id(0, 1, n), tt, inf, 0, r, head);

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; i++) {
            work(i, n, k, d, g, r, head, cur, vis, tag, dis, all);
        }

        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow();
        mcf.work(ss, tt, all, r, head, cur, vis, tag, dis);

        System.out.println(mcf.minw);
    }
}
